columns.name: user_yelping_since_year
columns.description: The time when the user join Yelp.

columns.name: user_fans
columns.description: The total number of fans / followers the user has

columns.name: num_5_star_reviews
columns.description: The number of 5-star reviews the user has given, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_business_reviewed
columns.description: The number of businesses the user has reviewed, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: received_funny_type_of_compliments
columns.description: Set to 1 if the user has received a funny type of compliment, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: is_an_elite_user_for_5_years_or_more
columns.description: Set to 1 if the user has been an elite user for 5 years or more, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: received_less_than_5_low_compliments_from_other_users
columns.description: Set to 1 if the user has received less than 5 low compliments from other users, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: active
columns.description: whether the business is still actively running until now

columns.name: city
columns.description: The city where the business is located.

columns.name: num_long_reviews
columns.description: The number of long reviews the business has received, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: is_under_the_category_of_Food_are_good_for_kids
columns.description: Set to 1 if the business is under the category of Food and are good for kids, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: average_review_star
columns.description: The average review star of the business

columns.name: has_more_than_10_attributes
columns.description: Set to 1 if the business has more than 10 attributes whose value is 'true', 0 otherwise.

columns.name: received_the_review_of_4_star_and_above_by_65_per_of_user
columns.description: Set to 1 if at least 65% of users have given the business a review of 4 stars or higher; otherwise, set to 0.
